question: Which player among the following is the twenty-third Woman Grandmaster of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Priyanka Nutakki.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nutakki Priyanka:-**

 
 
• She was born on 1 June 2002.
 
• She is an Indian chess player.
 
• She received the FIDE title of Woman International Master (WIM) in 2018.
 
• Priyanka Nutakki is the twenty-third Woman Grandmaster of India.
 
 
 
• Woman Grandmaster:-
 
 
• It is a title awarded by the World Chess Federation (FIDE) to women chess players who have achieved a certain level of proficiency in the game.
 
• India has produced many talented women chess players who have won several national and international tournaments.
 
• Some of the other notable women chess players in India include Koneru Humpy, Harika Dronavalli, Tania Sachdev, and Padmini Rout.
 
• Chess is a popular indoor game that requires strategic thinking, concentration, and patience.
 
• It is played by millions of people around the world and has been recognized as a sport by the International Olympic Committee.
